summary: Strong PREDICT-step pair. Lesson 3 explicitly bridges Day 2 data into prediction with Sap Sam, names the over-confident-prediction trap with a concrete range-based recovery, uses everyday paper materials, and lets children invent rules. Worksheet Parts 1-2 practise rule application; Part 3 transfers to a child's own real-life rule. Minor: worksheet does not echo the walkthrough's RANGE repair, so consistency lands at 3 — transfer task is justified but doesn't surface variability.
